title.en: Add agents from the marketplace in one step
title.zh: 从智能体市场一步添加

description.en: Selecting an agent in the marketplace opens its setup form directly. Its version, platforms and links are shown beside the form, and version history and uninstall remain under Manage.
description.zh: 在智能体市场中选择智能体后，将直接进入配置页面；版本、平台与相关链接显示在页面右侧，版本历史与卸载仍可通过「管理」进入。

title.zh: 智能体与工作区列表更清晰

description.en: Agents list their workspace and model, and each joined workspace is shown as a card. Filters, search and paging appear only when there is enough to narrow down.
description.zh: 智能体列表新增所在工作区与模型信息，已加入的工作区改为卡片展示；筛选、搜索与分页仅在内容较多时显示。

description.en: Status colours are reduced to a small dot, and the add-agent pages, settings and release notes follow the app's light and dark themes.
description.zh: 状态颜色收敛为小圆点，添加智能体页面、设置与更新公告均与应用的浅色、深色主题保持一致。

title.en: Language switch in the top bar

description.en: Switch the display language from the top bar; the collapsed sidebar now shows a short name under each icon.
description.zh: 可在顶栏直接切换界面语言；侧栏收起时，各图标下方会显示简短名称。

title.zh: 侧栏与打开工作区更稳定

description.en: The sidebar no longer stretches gradually after a language change, and opening a workspace right after the page loads no longer falls back to the browser.
description.zh: 切换语言后侧栏不再逐步变宽；页面刚打开时进入工作区，不会再误用浏览器打开。
